/docs.alt: Pyreon docs: Build the website. Get the apps.

/docs/a11y.alt: Accessibility documentation: announce('Saved') reaches screen readers with no provider and no setup; <LiveRegion>, <VisuallyHidden> and SSR-safe ids cover the rest.

/docs/atlas.alt: Atlas documentation: A component catalog derived from your components and types: controls from props, scenarios from variants, and a six-check verdict per scenario (a11y, interaction, leak, SSR parity, reactivity, snapshot).

/docs/auth.alt: Auth documentation: OIDC sign-in on web, iOS and Android from one call, with S256 PKCE, state, nonce and the issuer check on by default, plus signed sessions, TOTP and passkeys.

/docs/charts.alt: Charts documentation: Charts written as JSX marks (<Line>, <Bar>, <Area>) on Pyreon's own engine, with an accessible data table built in and the same source on iOS and Android.

/docs/cli.alt: Tooling documentation: pyreon doctor runs 15 gates and scores your project 0–100 with the fixes inline, next to 133 lint rules, pyreon check, a test kit and devtools for the reactive graph.

/docs/dnd.alt: Drag and Drop documentation: Drag and drop on Atlassian's pragmatic-drag-and-drop engine: sortable lists with keyboard reordering, file drop, and every drag state as a signal.

/docs/document.alt: Documents documentation: One template, 20 output formats: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, email, Markdown, Slack, Teams, Notion and more. Heavy renderers load only when used.

/docs/feature.alt: Feature documentation: Hand defineFeature a schema and an API path. Get list, detail, search, create, update and delete, plus the form, the table and the store.

/docs/flow.alt: Flow documentation: Node editors where each node mounts once and a drag touches one node, with auto-layout from its own engine: no elkjs, no D3.

/docs/form.alt: Forms documentation: Every field is its own signal, so typing in one field never touches the other eleven. Pass a Zod, Valibot or ArkType schema raw, no adapter.

/docs/guides/styling-theming.alt: Design System documentation: Eleven packages: styled() CSS-in-JS, components styled by state × size × variant × dark mode, a responsive grid and transitions, all cached and SSR-safe.

/docs/hooks.alt: Hooks documentation: 65 signal-based hooks for the browser and the phone, from useClickOutside and useMediaQuery to useCamera and useBiometrics.

/docs/hotkeys.alt: Hotkeys documentation: Scoped keyboard shortcuts with modifier keys and conflict detection, unregistered when their component unmounts.

/docs/http.alt: HTTP documentation: The request layer under Query: onion middleware, typed errors, cancellation and optional schema validation, on a zero-dependency core.

/docs/i18n.alt: i18n documentation: Translations with Intl-correct plurals, number, date and relative-time formatting, and namespaces that load when a page needs them.

/docs/kinetic.alt: Motion documentation: Enter, leave, collapse and stagger from one kinetic(tag) factory, 120+ presets, reduced motion detected for you, and SSR output crawlers can read.

/docs/lathe.alt: Lathe documentation: OpenAPI in, typed Pyreon client out: schemas, endpoints, query hooks, mocks and docs. lathe check fails CI when the generated code drifts from the spec.

/docs/loom.alt: Loom documentation: Your workspace's dependency graph as data: version drift, runtime cycles, phantom deps and blast radius, with a non-zero exit for CI.

/docs/machine.alt: State Machines documentation: A state machine that is a signal: it holds only the states you list and moves only by named events, with typed guards.

/docs/mcp.alt: AI and MCP documentation: An MCP server with 24 tools: your assistant looks up the real API, validates its code against Pyreon's misuse detectors and explains reactivity. No network calls.

/docs/migrating-from-react.alt: Migrate documentation: Compat layers for React, Preact, Vue, Solid and Svelte with near-full public-API parity: change the imports, keep shipping, port screens when it pays.

/docs/multiplatform.alt: Native documentation: Compile one .tsx into a real SwiftUI app and a real Jetpack Compose app, tested on an iOS Simulator and an Android emulator in CI. Experimental, and labelled that way.

/docs/permissions.alt: Permissions documentation: can('posts.edit') is a reactive check, so the UI follows when roles change. RBAC, ABAC, feature flags and plan tiers, with posts.* wildcards.

/docs/primitives.alt: Primitives documentation: 22 components, from <Stack> and <Field> to <Select> and <Modal>, that render DOM on the web and real SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose views on phones (native: experimental).

/docs/query.alt: Query documentation: TanStack Query on signals: data, error and isFetching are separate signals, and WebSocket and SSE hooks share the same cache.

/docs/reactivity.alt: Reactivity documentation: signal, computed, effect, batch: the core every Pyreon package runs on, and it works on its own.

/docs/rich-text.alt: Editors documentation: Rich text on TipTap and code on CodeMirror 6, where the document is a signal. Lazy-loaded languages, a minimap and a diff editor included.

/docs/router.alt: Router documentation: Params typed from the path string (/user/:id gives { id: string }), with loaders, guards, middleware, typed search params and View Transitions.

/docs/rx.alt: RX documentation: 42 functions (filter, sortBy, groupBy, pipe, debounce…) that take signals and return signals.

/docs/state-tree.alt: State Tree documentation: MobX-State-Tree-style models on signals: typed snapshots, JSON-patch record and replay, middleware, and per-request isolation on the server.

/docs/storage.alt: Storage documentation: Signals that persist: localStorage synced across tabs, sessionStorage, cookies the server can read, and IndexedDB, all behind one API.

/docs/store.alt: Store documentation: Global state is a setup function that returns signals and functions. Actions, patches, subscriptions and per-request SSR isolation come with it.

/docs/sync.alt: Sync documentation: Local-first sync where a synced value is a normal signal, so a remote edit is one DOM update. Yjs underneath, IndexedDB offline, a WebSocket relay with per-room auth.

/docs/table.alt: Table documentation: TanStack Table's headless core with signal-driven state and reactive options, rendered by Pyreon's fine-grained DOM.

/docs/toast.alt: Toast documentation: toast('Saved') from anywhere, no provider; toast.promise() for async work, and the timer pauses on hover, on focus and in a hidden tab.

/docs/url-state.alt: URL State documentation: useUrlState('page', 1) is a signal synced to the query string, with type coercion and replaceState, so filters survive a refresh and a pasted link.

/docs/validate.alt: Validation documentation: A chainable validator (s.string().email()) that speaks Standard Schema, with field metadata, reactive parse and translated errors built in.

/docs/virtual.alt: Virtual documentation: TanStack Virtual for element or window scrolling: a 10,000-row list with only the visible rows in the DOM.

/docs/zero.alt: Zero documentation: Every route picks its own rendering: SSG, SSR, ISR or SPA, plus islands, server actions and adapters for Node, Bun, Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare and static hosts.

/docs/zero-content.alt: Content documentation: Markdown and MDX compiled to real Pyreon JSX at build time, with Astro-style typed collections checked by your own Zod, Valibot or ArkType schema.
